editor.selectCharacter: Select a character to begin editing.

editor.deleteExpressionConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the expression “{{name}}”?
editor.layerConfigHint: Choose which asset from each layer is visible for this expression.
editor.spriteLayersHint: Layers stack on top of each other. Upload assets, then assign them per-expression.
editor.noLayersComposite: No layers yet. Layers let you build composite sprites (e.g., separate body, face, accessories).
editor.baseSpriteHint: Optional base image/video shown behind all layers for every expression.
editor.dialogueFontHint: Override the project default for this character's dialogue text.
editor.defaultVoiceHint: Audio clip to play automatically with every dialogue line for this character (can be overridden per-line).
editor.splitAssetHint: Give this sprite its own layer, so it always shows instead of being one of the choices (e.g. the whites, iris and pupil of an eye)

spriteImport.buttonHint: Import all your layers at once — drop many PNGs, or a Photoshop (.psd) / Krita (.ora) file
spriteImport.dropHere: Drop your layers here — PNGs, or a .psd / .ora file
spriteImport.title: Import sprites into {{char}}
spriteImport.hint: Drop your layer PNGs, or a Photoshop (.psd) / Krita (.ora) file.
spriteImport.found: We looked at your art and found {{layers}} layers. Check it over, then import.
spriteImport.failed: The import failed. Nothing was changed.
spriteImport.expressionsHint: We matched up names across your layers — e.g. happy eyes + a happy mouth make a "Happy" expression.
spriteImport.resize: Shrink to fit your game ({{fw}}×{{fh}} → {{tw}}×{{th}}) — keeps your project small
spriteImport.addToExisting: Add the new layers to expressions this character already has
spriteImport.aspectMismatch: This art is a different shape ({{nw}}×{{nh}}) from {{char}}'s existing sprites ({{ew}}×{{eh}}). If you import it, the new layers will not line up on stage. Re-export it at the same shape.
spriteImport.modeAlternativesHint: These are alternatives — the character shows ONE of them at a time (e.g. happy eyes OR sad eyes).
spriteImport.modePartsHint: These are pieces that build one thing — they all show together (e.g. the whites, iris and pupil of an eye). Each becomes its own layer.
spriteImport.partsNote: These all show together — each becomes its own layer ({{names}}).
spriteImport.splitOutHint: Give this image its own layer, so it always shows instead of being one of the choices
spriteImport.variantsNote: The character shows ONE of these at a time. If they are really pieces that stack together (like the whites, iris and pupil of an eye), switch to "Stack all" — or give a single image its own layer with "Own layer".

anim.rotLaneTip: The thin strip is the Spin/Tilt lane — click it to add a rotation key. The piece turns smoothly between keys, around the middle of its box, and never moves its real position.
anim.rotHint: The piece turns smoothly to this angle, spinning around the middle of its box. 360 = one full spin. Its real position never changes.
anim.adjustOpen: Move & pivot — move this piece while the animation plays, and choose the point it spins around
anim.adjustHint: Only while this animation plays — the layer’s real position never changes. Press ▶ to watch it live while you adjust.
anim.adjustMove: Move the piece while it plays
anim.adjustMoveHint: Negative sideways = left, negative up/down = up.
anim.adjustPivotHint: If the drawing sits off-centre in its box, move the pivot onto the drawing so a spin doesn’t swing it sideways.
anim.sclLaneTip: The lower strip is the Squash/Stretch lane — click it to add a size key. Width and height can differ, so the piece can squash flat or stretch tall. It sizes smoothly between keys, around the same pivot point as the spin.
anim.sclAdd: Add a size change at {{ms}} ms
anim.sclHint: The piece sizes smoothly to this width and height. Make them DIFFERENT for a squash (wider + flatter) or a stretch (narrower + taller). It sizes around the same pivot point as the spin (the ⌖ button). The layer’s real size never changes.
anim.nudgeHint: Lines this frame up with the others — drag the piece in the preview, or type. The faded copy is the previous frame. Only this animation moves; the layer itself stays put.
anim.nudgeDragHint: Drag the piece into place — arrow keys for tiny steps
anim.movLaneTip: The bottom strip is the Glide lane — click it to add a movement key. The piece slides SMOOTHLY between keys (unlike frame nudges, which snap with their frame). Great for sways, bobs and drifts.
anim.movAdd: Add a glide key at {{ms}} ms
anim.movHint: The piece slides smoothly to this position (percent of the character frame; negative = left/up). Unlike a frame nudge, this FLOWS between keys — perfect for sways and bobs. The layer’s real position never changes.
anim.liveHint: The preview follows as you slide — press ▶ to watch the whole motion with this change.
anim.movDragHint: Drag the piece to where it should glide — or use the sliders
anim.pivotShown: The ⌖ mark on the preview is the point the piece turns and sizes around.
anim.motLaneTip: This strip moves the WHOLE character — every piece together. Click it to add a movement key; the character slides smoothly between keys. Great for hops, leans, walks in place and full-body bobs. Their real spot on stage never changes.
anim.motChange: Change the whole-character move at {{ms}} ms
anim.motAdd: Add a whole-character move at {{ms}} ms
anim.motHint: The WHOLE character slides smoothly to this position — every piece together (percent of the character frame; negative = left/up). Great for hops, leans and full-body bobs. Their real spot on stage never changes.
anim.motDragHint: Drag the character to where it should move — or use the sliders
anim.duplicateTip: Make a same-character copy of this animation to tweak
anim.copyTip: Copy this animation — then open any character’s Animation Studio and press Paste. Rows land on layers with the same name.
anim.copied: Copied — open any character’s Animation Studio and press Paste
anim.pasteTip: Pastes the copied animation onto THIS character. Rows land on layers with the same name; the rest say “Pick a layer…”.
anim.pasteMatched: Matched {{m}} of {{n}} rows by layer name — unmatched rows say “Pick a layer…”
anim.laneCopy: Copy this strip’s keys — paste them on any matching strip, even another character’s
anim.laneCopied: Keys copied — a Paste button appears on matching strips
anim.lanePaste: Paste {{n}} copied keys here — replaces this strip’s keys (undo brings them back)
anim.pasteLate: Some keys sit after {{ms}} ms — lengthen the animation to play them

fx.title: Text effects
fx.hint: Make their words or their name move. You can also wrap part of a name in tags like [wave]…[/wave] right in the name field.
fx.name: Their name (in the name box)
